# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 48,989 across 2 platforms (youtube: 41,658, instagram: 7,331).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-09-20.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 85.1%, neutral 7.7%, negative 7.3%.
- youtube: positive 62.2%, neutral 21.4%, negative 16.4%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.489, neutral 0.496, positive 0.505 (spread 0.016).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T4: agent, new, real, think - 24,539 posts.
- T0: business, help, digitalmarketing, brand - 5,434 posts.
- T10: understand, easy, easy understand, simple - 2,473 posts.
- T7: time, real time, save time, save - 2,025 posts.
- T6: rich, broke, dumb, broke dumb - 1,536 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T0: business, help, digitalmarketing, brand (+4.38 pts).
- Rising: T10: understand, easy, easy understand, simple (+0.83 pts).
- Rising: T1: clear, wish, understandable, clear understandable (+0.47 pts).
- Declining: T4: agent, new, real, think (-1.49 pts).
- Declining: T6: rich, broke, dumb, broke dumb (-2.45 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 9,337 posts.
- AI Agents - 7,659 posts.
- Automation - 5,205 posts.
- Startup - 4,733 posts.
- SEO - 3,699 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=11, UMass coherence -0.243 (more coherent than LDA).
